6279.title: Observed child model is dropped before timeline projection
6279.rootCauseOneLine: Child assistant models are not carried through background-task deltas/events, and timeline projection only has a requested-model fallback.
6279.proposedFix: Propagate an observed task model through typed bridge/event metadata and prefer it during timeline enrichment; not eligible for a schema-free single-subsystem autopilot fix.
6279.caveats: Repeated source-level translation/assembly/timeline reproduction; no live macOS/provider session or completion/sibling/synthetic acceptance verification.
